title: ReportMetric
description: report.metric@1: one number OpenVibe.Report computed or ingested, with its scope and either its UTC day (a day series) or its window. Counts only. Money values are Billing's, read through Billing's API; Report never derives them.

metric.description: The number's name: pageviews, accounts_new, coins_earned, live_now, streams, stream_seconds, messages, watch_minutes, traffic_p95_ms, revenue_bits, refund_bits, ...

scope_id.description: network for the network scope; a site id (network, live, ...), a channel username, or a stream id.

day.description: The UTC day this number belongs to. Present on a day row.

window_days.description: The window this number is for. Present on a window row.

source.description: network-stats, live, billing, report, or the job that wrote it.
